mobbin:f4a1c6f0-b7ae-427b-a896-b4f3c2535.summary: From For you the user taps TV Nearby, picks Living Room TV from a Wi-Fi/Bluetooth discovery list, confirms selection, sees Turning on…, then a persistent Connected bar with remote shortcut.
steps: Select a device — Living Room TV list
Select a device — Living Room TV checked
Toast — Turning on Living Room TV…
Connected bar — Living Room TV + remote
steal: Named device in AVAILABLE DEVICES (step 2) — room/screen identity before control.
Green check on selected TV (step 3) — confirm which screen before committing.
Turning on… toast then Connected + named TV (steps 4–5) — async power/link feedback.
Persistent Connected bar with remote shortcut (step 5) — stay in context while linked to the big screen.
avoid: Five-step same-network Wi-Fi/Bluetooth discovery (steps 1–5) — slow and brittle vs a QR on the debrief display for faculty pairing.
mobbin:f4a1c6f0-b7ae-427b-a896-b4f3c2535.fit: Counter-example for debrief pairing: multi-step nearby discovery does not beat a QR-linked web page on the phone; keep named-screen + Connected chrome if pairing is QR-first.

mobbin:3f1ac467-e548-499a-91bf-cd1e5a74a.summary: While browsing a title with Living Room TV already connected, the user opens the full remote and gets touchpad nav plus play/pause, seek, and ±30s skips for the big screen.
steps: Title detail — Connected bar with pause
steal: Docked bar naming Living Room TV with pause while browsing (step 1) — control without leaving context.
Connected header on the remote sheet (step 2) — always show which screen is driven.
±30s skip flanking the scrubber (step 2) — coarse jumps for debrief moments without precise scrubbing.
Large mute / vol targets under the touchpad (step 2) — one-hand glanceable AV controls.
avoid: Full swipe-to-navigate touchpad as primary (step 2) — debrief needs timeline/bookmarks, not TV focus navigation.
mobbin:3f1ac467-e548-499a-91bf-cd1e5a74a.fit: Mobile beats desktop for faculty standing in the room driving the debrief big screen: preferred as a web remote with named screen + transport/±skip after QR pair — extends Baseline private annotations / screen control.
